summary: Only 10 m of kerb, at a junction mouth with no room to stop.

drivers.seclusion: Houses are 30 m or more away behind a wall and trees, but the stretch is too short to use.
drivers.access_and_room: 10 m of kerb ending at a junction; no verge or pull-in, bank and trees beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Through road leading into a junction with moving cars.
drivers.convention: No signs on this stretch; no parked cars seen on this side.

flags: Low-lying: min elevation about 3.9 m, Witton Creek 29 m away
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over the east end; open to the south.
